coupling: The edge-sweep commit changes x_max from an inclusive last touched column to an exclusive end and updates its narrow SIMD/scalar consumer and trailing fill. The later wide-accumulator commit adds a separate consumer that still iterates through x_max inclusively; its edited conservative threshold selects that path at 127 active edges. The probe supplies exactly 127 in-contract edges clipped at the final surface column, making x_max equal width and causing the wide consumer to read beyond its area and cover arrays. The earlier edit is safe with its then-only narrow consumer, and the later threshold edit is safe with the original inclusive producer. The repair requires carrying the bound convention across both commits and both consumers.
